overview_description.description: jEugene jumpstarts definitions checks. In seconds, it highlights undefined terms and unused definitions right in the text of documents, so that lawyers can focus on harder problems. Not so long ago, a corporate associate experienced firsthand the stress of definitions checking. Catching all undefined terms and unused definitions is hard, especially when time is short and terms complex.
